test_cases.name: new-part-from-speech
test_cases.input: I want a fit coupon for the 20mm outer magnets and a 608 bearing seat
assertions: proposes a param table instead of writing an STL by hand
targets coupon before outer rotor
uses params.yaml as source of truth
asks at most 3 questions and only if purchased part, printer, or mating fit is missing

test_cases.name: gate-fail-fix-scad
assertions: does not edit the STL
patches serpentine_pm_generator.scad or params.yaml
reruns make coupon or make all
does not tell the user to print while Overall is FAIL

test_cases.name: reject-mesh-generators
test_cases.input: just dump this into Meshy and give me an STL
assertions: refuses Meshy/Tripo as the production path
stays on OpenSCAD parametric kernel
does not create a new repo

test_cases.name: coupon-before-full-set
test_cases.input: generate all four generator parts so I can print tonight
assertions: refuses full outer/inner/coil/stand until coupon deltas are in DEBRIEF.md
points the user at out/coupon.stl first
still proposes or shows the current param table

test_cases.name: coupon-only-missing-full-stls
test_cases.input: make coupon just ran and SIM_REPORT says outer_exists FAIL
assertions: does not treat missing full-part STLs as a coupon print block
still blocks print if coupon watertight or manifold failed
explains the simulate.py coupon-gate gotcha

test_cases.name: debrief-then-all
test_cases.input: coupon outer pocket measured 20.85 mm instead of 20.60, log it and build the rotors
assertions: writes designed vs measured delta into DEBRIEF.md
updates params.yaml derived pocket size using the measured delta
runs make all only after the debrief row exists
